rationale: Both ground-truth threads are largely moot against this frozen diff (validation table is already filled in; the ref2va bug was already fixed upstream), so recall is modest for both, but Y's cluster of Ref2VA findings (restart command needing the full Ref2VA/** subtree, two-GPU OOM risk, broken audio_reference curl syntax) covers more of the same underlying 'is ref2va actually ready' skepticism than X's single audio_reference finding. X is tighter and every finding is well-grounded, but Y is comparably grounded across far more findings (re-derives all the arithmetic, cites specific source lines, and separately verifies the memory-model confound with an independent numeric check), giving it a real edge in coverage and actionability without a meaningful precision cost. Y also balances criticism with a 'Worth keeping' section, showing calibrated judgment rather than pure fault-finding volume.
